definitions.explanation: A stationery item that applies a thin strip of opaque white film to cover mistakes in handwriting or printing, allowing the user to write over the corrected area.

examples.japanese: {修正|しゅうせい}テープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: I covered the mistake with correction tape.

examples.japanese: {修正|しゅうせい}テープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧？
examples.english: Could you lend me your correction tape?

examples.japanese: {修正液|しゅうせいえき}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{修正|しゅうせい}テープ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}たなくて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Correction tape is more convenient than correction fluid because you don't have to wait for it to dry.

notes:
A common stationery item found in virtually every Japanese office and school. Japan is known for producing high-quality correction tape, with brands like Tombow's MONO being particularly popular.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修正|しゅうせい}テープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use correction tape
- {修正|しゅうせい}テープ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え: correction tape refill
- {修正|しゅうせい}テープ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{直|なお}す: to fix with correction tape

RELATED WORDS:
- {修正液|しゅうせいえき}: correction fluid, white-out — liquid version that needs drying time
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧: correction pen — pen-shaped applicator for correction fluid
- ⟦{消|け}しゴム→消しゴム：00716_keshigomu⟧: eraser — for pencil marks only

CULTURAL NOTE:
Correction tape is extremely popular in Japan. Many varieties exist, from ultra-slim types for small text to extra-wide types for larger corrections. Refillable models are also common.
